summary: DynaResource filed an 8-K announcing a non-brokered private placement with existing stockholders to raise US$3.0 million (US$6.4 million if warrants exercised). Units priced at US$0.45 per unit, each unit consisting of one common share and one warrant with a US$0.51 exercise price, conditional on an authorized share increase. The company received a US$851,250 advance, but completion depends on finalizing definitive documentation; proceeds will cover general corporate purposes, working capital, debt service, and capital expenditures. Watch for execution of definitive documentation and shareholder approval for warrant exercise.
